info.title: EvidenceBridge local demo API
info.description: Four owned synthetic candidate workflows, fixed job/rubric and three targeted templates. V1 plus at most one approved V2 per person. Assessment, evidence review and human shortlist are separate. Loopback demo; no authentication or automated hiring rank.

get.summary: Storage readiness; never invokes a model
Read one explicitly selected candidate; no implicit Alex
Same-stage application comparison; task assessments kept separate

post.summary: Save an entire owned criterion group atomically; deterministic server scores
Human retain/remove/reconfirm with material and assessment basis
Send one fixed SQL, DA or BPS target template per candidate
Save V1 or an explicitly permitted V2; private notes are excluded
Extract and validate observations from the exact saved submission
Save one human evidence decision; only the target requirement changes
Reset synthetic case; old submission references become stale
